lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The stairwell is two doors down. The building has eleven floors of people under us and one way out.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then one way out will have to be enough.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Smoke on the landing. Keep your head low and your hand on the rail.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Your heart rate is 140. The current follows it. Breathe out, and push.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I am pushing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Not with your arms.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: What did you just do up there?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Keep moving. I will tell you when I know.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Eleven floors. The service stairs hold. The main ones do not.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Noted. I will stop saying it. I will keep measuring it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: A road that goes somewhere new. That is not the worst thing on this street.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is the worst thing. The things on this street came down it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Cover. Movement. Ability. In that order?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: In whichever order keeps you alive.

lines.speaker: SURVIVOR
lines.text: They are through. The train is through. Who are you?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Somebody who lives on twelve.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Lived.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator response team at the bastion. Armoured, calm, and counting you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Counting me as what?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That is the question they will ask.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: That is more than most people decide in a week.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: She is recording you. So am I. Mine is the one you can read.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Armory. Draw what you can carry. Nobody gets issued more than they can explain.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I can explain a rifle.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Good. Explain the rest to me tomorrow.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Breach signatures at the plaza. Two squads of Vanguard drones, one of them already leaking.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Leaking what?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Whatever the purple light is made of.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: District clear. Vale watched the whole thing from the wall.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then she has her proof.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: You held the district. So. Where do you stand?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Recorded. Both of us will remember this one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The scout's trail runs north. She has not used the same route twice.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Careful, or lost?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Careful. Lost people repeat themselves.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: Then stay on the moss. The forest keeps count of what you break.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Signal source: a seed vault, pre-Fracture, still sealed.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: Still sealed means still hers. Leave it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We leave it. We note where it is.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: Note it in your head, not on the map.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Hostile fauna. The forest has decided what you are.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It is wrong.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Convince it.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: You did not burn anything.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Was that the test?

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: That was the first one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Warden's people have seen us since the falls. They let us walk.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That is either trust or a trap.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: In this forest it is usually the same thing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Left. No — the left just closed. Straight, then.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Extraction site. Vanguard drills, abandoned in a hurry. The forest is still digesting the camp.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: They took the heartwood. The trees took them. Now you decide what happens to the rest.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The dungeon is settling. It will not look like this tomorrow.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Nothing here does.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Solara. Forty-six degrees in the shade and the shade is for sale.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who sells shade?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Everyone here.

lines.speaker: RACER
lines.text: Rook's new charity case. Try to keep the car in one country.

lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: You won. In a storm. In that.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You said we could negotiate.

lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: I said we can. Pull in. The front end is talking to me and it is not saying nice things.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He is proud of you. He will deny it under any questioning.

lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: Nobody drives into the Ribcage. The sand there is bone, and the bone is somebody's.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The signal is in there.

lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: So is the thing that makes the signal.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Thermal bloom ahead, airborne, forty metres across. Rook is understating it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its hull is at four percent and it is kneeling. That is not a surrender. It is a decision.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we honour it.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: RAIDERS NEST IN THE OLD COLONNADE. THEY HAVE NOT LEARNED TO WALK LIGHTLY.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You fly, I walk. Call the ones I cannot see.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: I CALL. YOU LISTEN. THAT IS THE OATH, LITTLE OPERATOR.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: YOU DID NOT STAND IN MY SHADOW ONCE.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You said watch the shadow before the dive.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: I SAID IT TO MY ENEMIES.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Bond strengthened. No reward granted. Both of you seem to prefer it that way.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Neon City. Twenty-two million cameras. I can see through nine of them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Which nine?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The ones she lets me.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Cyan Loop. Four laps, no rules the Syndicate will admit to. The driver you need is the one you beat.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three of the cars are armed. One of them is hers.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: She did not let me see that camera.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: A civilian in a street car. The Syndicate is going to want to know your name.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The doors, Sable.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Opening. The signal you want comes from under the Aegis tower. Nobody comes back up the way they went down.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The source is a relay the size of a room, and it is pointed at Nexus City.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Pointed at what in Nexus City?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: At you. At the building you woke up in. Pull the logs.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Logs copied. The relay was switched on eleven days before the Fracture.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Somebody knew.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Somebody built it.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: And somebody is now coming down the stairs. Out. The other way.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Hull pressure rising. Neri is humming.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Is that good?

lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: It is better than me talking.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The shadow is circling. It has not decided.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: Old. Older than the city. We give it the lane and it gives us the port.

lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: Dock sealed. Welcome to Thalassia. Mind the ceiling; it is the ocean.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Unknown life signature departing. It looked at you for eleven seconds.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Did it like what it saw?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It did not eat the submersible.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Glass domes, kelp gardens, a market. A whole city that was never told it should be afraid of the surface.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It should be.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It knows. The archive is why we came.

lines.speaker: DIVER
lines.text: Surface walker. The Archivist expects you. She expects everyone; she is rarely wrong.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: DIVER
lines.text: Where the light is oldest.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The archive runs on an architecture I recognise. I did not expect to recognise anything down here.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
lines.text: Three volumes were cut from the record the year before the first Fracture. Their shelves still hum.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I can hear them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then lead.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Carefully. The stacks are flooding and something in the water is reading over our shoulder.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three records. The first Fracture was not an accident. The second was a repeat.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Of what?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Of an experiment with my name on it.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
lines.text: Now you know what the archive costs. Decide what it is worth.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
lines.text: Taken, it may save the surface and it will never come back. Kept, it stays safe and stays silent. Choose.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Logged. Neri has the submersible warm.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Does the shadow know we are leaving?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is already in the lane.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Minus thirty-one. Wind from the glacier. Your suit's heaters are at full and I am not satisfied.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: Stay in my prints. Where I have not walked, the ice has not been asked.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The transmission is louder. Older too — the encoding is pre-NOVA.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Is there anything older than you?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Apparently.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: The caverns. In. Before the storm notices us.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Shelter. Heaters back to seventy. The signal is coming from inside the ice.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The distress call is a loop. Eighteen seconds, repeating for nineteen years.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who sent it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A research station. Frosthold. The crew list is in the loop. One name is Vale.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: Movement in the ice. Weapons.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: Whatever they were, they were people once. They were not sent here to die; they were left.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we find who left them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The loop ends with a location. The summit. Something there calls itself a crown.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The storm has a centre and the centre is a machine. It is holding the crew in the ice like a memory.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Alive?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Held. That is all I will say until we see it.

lines.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
lines.text: EACH ANCHOR YOU BREAK IS A WINTER I KEPT THEM THROUGH.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The crown is down. The storm is just a storm now.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: The crew. Nine of them. Breathing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Nineteen years.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have their memories in the crown's log. One of them is mine. I will show you, when we are warm.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Nexus City. The avenue is open, the trains run, and there are posters with your face on them. Two kinds.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Which kind is winning?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The one with the better printer.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three factions in one plaza. Vanguard, Syndicate runners, and the people who live here. Somebody brought masks.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Whose side are the masks?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Their own. Keep the civilians behind you and do not fire first.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Nobody died. In this city, today, that is a political statement.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I did not make it for politics.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: That is why it worked.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Fracture Market is not a place. It is Sable's phone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we talk to the phone.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: One crate, three buyers, one of you. Drive it to the harbor and the contract is real.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The crate is Fracture-grade. It is humming at the frequency of your apartment.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Everything is, lately.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Harbor. The buyers are here. All three.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Told you. Everyone pays. Now choose who.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: The district's people, or the people with an army. Pick.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Contract closed. Two factions are now very interested in you and one is grateful. I cannot tell you which is worse.

lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: Sky dock in sight and it is crawling. I cannot put down on that.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Drop me. Clear it.

lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: You are going to jump out of my aircraft.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You are going to let me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: She is. She is also swearing.

lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: Down. Thank you. Never again.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The seam is above us. It is not weather and it is not closing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where does it lead?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Everywhere the Fracture has touched. Including home.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A spire on the far island is talking to the seam. Same encoding as the Neon relay.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Same builder.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Same builder.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The spire's log names the next stop: Obsidian Reach, and a marshal who has been expecting a visitor for a year.

lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: The Reach does not like visitors.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Nobody does, lately.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Obsidian Reach. Every ridge is a battlefield that was never cleared. The marshal's people live between the craters.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And he wants?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: To know whether you are the next war.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Raiders from the wastes, armed by someone with Syndicate money. If you walk away, the ruins burn and the families in them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I am not walking.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Then walk with us. Left flank. Do not fire on anyone who drops a weapon.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: You held fire on the ones who ran.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You said not to.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Most people hear that as a suggestion.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The accord stands. Draev will answer when the factions are called. He will not say so.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then who knows how?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Someone has been walking this coast for years, marking nothing.

lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: The vault opens for the ones who do not knock. Stand where the tide stands. Wait.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How long?

lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: Until you stop asking.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The vault opened. Nothing attacked. Something watched, and then it left a mark on your map that I did not draw.

lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: One of eighteen. The rest will not use the same door. Do not look for the pattern; look for the world.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I am starting to.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Your choice at the vault changed the tide here. Something that lives in the rifts has come up to see who did it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Friendly?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Attentive.

lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: Do not kill it unless it insists.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It withdrew. It left a second mark. There is no reward and I will not invent one.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The attention is the reward.

lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: Now you sound like someone the legends might talk to.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The partition is in the calibration lab, under the bastion. It will show you what I am. I would like you to see it before anyone else does.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Will it hurt you?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I do not know. That is new.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There. I was built to find the host the Fracture wanted. I found you instead and I chose to stay quiet about why.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Because you would have left. And the building would have fallen with everyone in it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No more omissions.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: None. Ask me anything.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Opening the partition sent a signal. Vanguard drones are responding to it. I am sorry.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You said ask you anything. Where are they?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Everywhere. Left first.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Clear. I have no secrets left that could do that to you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Keep one or two. Just tell me they exist.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Two. They exist.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Draev's line, Vale's line, the Warden's rangers in the scrub. One of them fires in the next minute unless you do something.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Somebody fired anyway. Not one of ours. Syndicate marksmen on the ridge, paid to make this happen.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then everybody has the same enemy for ninety seconds.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Make it count.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: The ridge is quiet. My people are alive. So are Draev's.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Then we are not enemies today.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Today is what I can promise.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Alliance held. Consequences logged. They will persist whether or not anyone wants them to.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Everything we found points here. The Neon relay, the spire, the archive, the crown. The first crack in the world is a place.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: I FLY ABOVE. I DO NOT LIKE WHAT IS BELOW.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: The forest sent me. It does not send people.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we go in together.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The heart is open. What it was protecting is a machine, and the machine has a door with your apartment number on it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It knew you before you did. Home, then. We finish this where it started.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Convergence Engine. It wants one reality. It built me to pick it. We are going to refuse.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Together.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Together. Three anchors. Then the choice is yours, not its.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is quiet. Not healed. Quiet.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That will do for today.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: So. What do you do with a world you kept?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Campaign complete. The world is still running. So are we.
